conservative_investor.name: Conservative Investor
conservative_investor.primary_goal: Capital preservation and steady retirement corpus growth
conservative_investor.notes: Prioritizes capital preservation. Avoids high-volatility momentum plays. Prefers dividend-paying large caps.

balanced_investor.name: Balanced Investor
balanced_investor.primary_goal: Grow wealth steadily while limiting downside during corrections
balanced_investor.notes: Diversifies across large caps and select growth names. Rebalances quarterly. Willing to accept moderate drawdowns for above-FD returns.

aggressive_investor.name: Aggressive Investor
aggressive_investor.primary_goal: Maximize short-term trading gains through momentum swings
aggressive_investor.notes: Comfortable with high volatility for higher returns. Actively trades momentum and mid/small-cap swings. History of holding through 15%+ drawdowns.
